item.description: RSKSwap is a decentralized exchange to automatically exchange ERC20 tokens, there is no need to wait for a buyer or seller. It has the advantage of the low costs and security of the RSK network. It also doesn’t require KYC and has no limits for withdrawals or deposits. In this webinar you will have a step-by-step guide to create your own token and exchange it in RSKSwap automatically, using smart contracts.
